title: Warren Pulse (SID)
message:
Hexwarren's in-Warren loop (warren_pulse.it) for the SID's three voices + sound effects.
Voice 1 bass + kick, voice 2 kit, voice 3 drone / pad / hunter call. Sections: the cleared and fallen stings
and the boss music (crone_duel.it). Source: songs/hexwarren_warren_pulse_sid.gen.js

patterns.name: 24 boss: rebuild and cadence, then the start
